cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?
